pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena brāhmaṇena saṃghassa payopānaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.4: aññataro naṭapubbako bhikkhu evam āha: sabb'
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu saṃghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ karissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.8: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu saṃghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ akāsīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.11: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṃghaṃ ārabbha davaṃ karissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.12: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.15: na bhikkhave buddhaṃ vā dhammaṃ vā saṃghaṃ vā ārabbha davo kātabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.17: atha kho bhagavā taṃ bhikkhuṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk51:1.18: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
